english.notes: No minimum published (re-read 2026-10-20). https://admissions.upenn.edu/how-to-apply/international-applicants lists the accepted tests ('We accept TOEFL , IELTS Academic , and the Duolingo English Test') and gives only guidance: 'Competitive applicants tend to have a composite score of 5 or above' (new TOEFL scale), 'Competitive applicants tend to have a composite score of 100 or above' (0-120 TOEFL), Duolingo 'Competitive applicants should have an overall score of 130 or above'. These are competitive levels, not minimums, so nothing is drafted.
